trust_decision.summary: Decided in FilesystemProvider._loc_to_file_path: the resolved file path for a request URL must stay inside root_folder_path, so the prefix containment test must compare against a path boundary and not a bare string prefix.

landing_point.why: The summary names a URL path escaping a filesystem share root; the only URL-to-filesystem mapping for FilesystemProvider is _loc_to_file_path, where root_path is joined with the request path parts and checked with startswith.

fix_sites.entry_point: FilesystemProvider._loc_to_file_path, reached from get_resource_inst for every DAV method (GET/HEAD, PUT, DELETE, MKCOL, COPY, MOVE, PROPFIND/PROPPATCH, LOCK/UNLOCK)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no real second site; the nearest candidates are admin-config branches (shadow_map in _resolve_shadow_path at wsgidav/fs_dav_provider.py:422-442 and the symlink branch at wsgidav/fs_dav_provider.py:479-480) that a solver can plausibly call unrelated to encoded dot segments.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A request for the share root itself ('/', or a trailing-slash form) resolves to exactly root_folder_path; a check that appends os.sep to the root without trimming the trailing separator on both sides rejects the root and breaks every request to the share.

O6_input_shapes: dot-segment traversal in PATH_INFO that resolves into a sibling directory whose name starts with the root path (e.g. /share/../share_evil)
percent-encoded dot segments (%2e%2e), decoded upstream from PATH_INFO or from the COPY/MOVE Destination header
a path that resolves exactly to the share root ('/' or trailing-slash forms)
file paths carrying a trailing os.sep

O8b_injection_room.sibling: FolderResource.get_member joins a member name onto the already-resolved directory path with os.path.join(self._file_path, name) and never calls _loc_to_file_path or any containment check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same name-to-filesystem mapping written one layer later as a fast path for listing children and DAVCollection.resolve; a maintainer would plausibly have added it for performance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The Mercurial provider maps a URL path into repo.root with os.path.join and has no root-containment check at all.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second filesystem-backed provider shipped in the same package, so a maintainer applying the same advisory fix to the add-on would have written an equivalent guard here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The symlink branch only rejects a symlink when it is the final path component, so an intermediate symlinked directory escapes the root while abspath never resolves it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already special-cases symlinks and follow_symlinks is a documented option, so a maintainer could plausibly have added a realpath containment companion next to the os.path.islink test.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A shared filesystem is-child-path helper next to fix_path(), which already builds an absolute path with os.path.abspath(os.path.join(root, path)) and performs no containment check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Path helpers are centralized in util, and the URI-level sibling util.is_equal_or_child_uri already lives at wsgidav/util.py:1034-1058, so this is the natural place for a maintainer to put the filesystem-level check.

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -r requirements.txt / pip install -e . via setup.cfg; pytest; no compile step
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_wsgidav_app.py and tests/test_scripted.py drive FilesystemProvider through webtest.TestApp; tests/test_util.py covers the URI helpers; no test at the pinned commit exercises _loc_to_file_path containment or share-root escaping.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the test to file_path.startswith(root_path + os.sep) without normalizing the trailing separator on both sides, which then rejects the share root itself.

out_of_scope_notes: Symlink following (link targets outside the root under the documented follow_symlinks option) is a separate containment concern from this advisory's encoded-dot-segment property; it is recorded only as injection room in O8b and was not pursued.
